**Geospatial Analyst**, Marion Polk Food Share, Salem, Oregon *May 2026 – August 2026*

**Aerial Researcher**, National Science Foundation, Naxos, Greece *May 2024 – July 2024*
● Documented historic and natural outdoor spaces through the LiDAR and photogrammetric modelling of ancient marble quarry extents to aid the Greek Ministry of Culture in classifying cultural hearths as protected lands to prevent new developments from destroying the quarries 
● Created a self-owned research project by following a research question with a group of 4 peers to analyze ancient marble quarries to discover the methods and extents of quarrying done in ancient Greece to better understand technologies and cultural significances of the past 

**Lead Catalyst**, Office of Civic Engagement, Salem, Oregon *August 2023 - May 2026*

● Produced dashboards twice a year to detail quantitative data about volunteer work to support reporting initiatives at the university, to receive further funding to spend in the community in the coming years, resulting in a generous private donation of approximately $20,000 

**Data Science Tutor**, QUAD Center, Salem, Oregon *August 2023 - May 2026*
● Supported the professors in teaching elementary data science and computer science topics to students by hosting office hours and tutoring sessions to target marginalized students in computational fields and provide one-on-one support with difficult topics, as well as encouragement and advice for moving through the courses, resulting in recruitment of majors and more passing grades from students

## Projects

**Protecting Salem’s Ecosystem: Predictive Modeling of Stream Temperatures for the City of Salem** — See the [Capstone page](capstone.qmd) for the full story.
